# GrowthBook x Breeze Airways: Webinar Theme Sync
Date: 2026-11-17 | Duration: 32.880001068115234m

## Summary
The discussion planned a flexible webinar covering Claude experimentation workflows, a custom stakeholder-facing portal using dimension-based result slicing and GrowthBook API integration, experimentation culture, and engineering enablement through feature-flag guidance and the Conversational Cloud Code plugin. Two people currently design between 5 and 14 experiments monthly, while teams continue developing their testing maturity and increasingly use non-inferiority tests. AI has documented experimentation guidance, strengthened junior contributors’ test plans, and increased demand for analytics and data, with two additional headcount planned. A revised authentication test produced positive results for mobile, while the web test was expected to finish within one week. The business context included approaching four profitability quarters, 40–50% annual growth, and sustained conversion rates. Webinar preparation includes an outline, abstract, title, slide review, rehearsal, marketing support, scheduling, and follow-up communication.

## Keywords
Experimentation culture, Claude Code, Feature flags, Non-inferiority testing, Experimentation ROI, GrowthBook API
